top.name: Bigger Blast
top.description: Bigger shells deliver a bigger blast radius. Wiki: This upgrade increases the pierce of Mortar Monkey's shells by +20 and increases the radius of all attacks by 1.4×. The main blast increases radius from 20 to 28. Certain crosspaths receive additional benefits from Bigger Blast: Signal Flare: the decamo blast's pierce is increased by +40. Crosspaths also provide additional benefits for path 3, such as increasing the damage-over-time's tick damage: Shattering Shells: damage per tick increases from from 5 to 8, and the MOAB-Class Bloons damage per tick increases from 20 to 25. top.name: Shell Shock
top.description: Blast shockwave stuns Bloons at impact, pops bloons in a wider area, and increases Burny Stuff damage. Wiki: Shell Shock increases its blast radius by 10 (28 to 38) and creates additional explosions: a stunning blast that affects Bloons in a small area, and a shockwave that deals damage in a wider radius. The shockwave deals 1 damage (but cannot damage multiple layers, even if given damage buffs) within 57 radius, but can not hit Bloons within 50% of its blast radius, or DDTs. The stunning blast has 19 radius and stuns Bloons for 0.5 seconds except for Black and Zebra Bloons, even if given a Black-popping buff. With the Burny Stuff crosspath Shell Shock gains the following improvements: +1 damage to burn (from 1 to 2) Tick cooldown decreased from 1.25 seconds to 0.625 seconds (0.375 seconds with Extra Burny Stuff)

top.name: The Big One
top.description: Devastating explosions pop 10 layers. Increases Burny Stuff damage further. Wiki: This upgrade creates much larger explosions that do more damage, pop more Bloons, and stun longer. The outer shockwave's damage type is changed to Normal, popping all visible Bloon types, but the other explosions remain unable to pop Black Bloons. Main explosion: Radius is increased by 20 (38 to 58), pierce increased from 45 to 85, and damage from 3 to 10. Shockwave: Radius is increased by 30 (57 to 87), pierce increased from 45 to 85, and damage from 1 to 2 (with another +2 damage to Ceramics). Can also target visible DDTs. Stun blast: Radius increased by 10 (19 to 29), pierce increased from 45 to 85, and stun duration increased from 0.5 seconds to 0.75 seconds. With the 4-0-2 crosspath, the Burny Stuff burn damage is increased from 2 to 12. It still burns every 0.625 seconds (0.375 seconds with Extra Burny Stuff) and lasts up to 3.85 seconds.

middle.name: Pop and Awe
middle.description: Pop and Awe has permanent rapid attack speed. Pop and Awe Ability: rains explosions over the whole screen, damaging Bloons and stunning them periodically. Wiki: This upgrade replaces Artillery Battery's Bombardment ability with the Pop and Awe ability, which stuns all Bloons and blimps (excluding BADs and Bosses, while allowing all others to inch forward), does 20 damage per second to everything on the screen and immediately to any newly spawned Bloon, has a cooldown of 60 seconds, and lasts for 8 seconds. With the 0-5-2 crosspath, the ability also applies Burny Stuff that deals 36 damage per tick of every 1.25 seconds for up to 7.5 seconds. Pop and Awe also gains a permanent 4× attack speed compared to Artillery Battery (with the ability inactive). In addition, bonus damage against stunned targets is increased (+2 → +8), and the blast radius is increased from 20 to 23 (28 to 32.2 with 1/2-5-0). With the 0-5-2 crosspath, the Burny Stuff's damage per tick is increased from 6 to 20 and its duration is increased from 3.75 seconds to 7.5 seconds. Pop and Awe also grants all Artillery Batteries +1 BAD/Boss damage but it does not give this buff to itself.

bottom.name: Shattering Shells
bottom.description: Shattering shells strip special Bloon properties off all but the biggest bloons. Burny stuff melts through 5 layers with each shot and burns MOAB-class Bloons for extra damage. Wiki: Each shot removes all Camo and Regrow modifiers (including from Boss Bloons), and all Fortified modifiers from up to BFB (plus DDT with Paint Stripper). Its main explosion strips Regrow and Fortified modifiers, and its secondary no-damage blast strips both Camo and Regrow. The burn effect from Shattering Shells is improved to deal 5 damage per tick, and gains an additional burn that only targets MOAB-class, dealing 20 damage per tick. This blimp-only burn also affects DDTs. On any non-DDT blimp, it effectively does 25 damage per tick. Both the ordinary burn and blimp-only burn are affected by Extra Burny Stuff. Crosspathing with 2-0-4 further increases the burn effect to 8 damage and its blimp-only burn to 25, totalling 33 per tick on any non-DDT.
